caption_zh: 航向精度的滤波与因子图比较，并补齐已完成的FGO定位路线。（a–f）三条自然记录中的有符号航向误差和绝对误差累计分布，全部六方法使用共同名义动态时刻274/267/367点。灰带为登记遮挡，缺少动态输出处断线。文献/标定配置与原登记起点保留。（g,h）首个登记20秒位置中断航向过程，以及全部18个条件的全窗航向RMSE；灰色点划线为保留基线IEKF，黑短线为中位数。（i）OiSAM、TC-FGO、GNC-FGO在同一GNSS1天线点的既有水平RMSE，采用它们独立登记的共同动态支持274/267/369点。TC/GNC不自行估计姿态，因此这里只展示其定位；本文现有位置比较点为POI，不混入该天线点面板。原始码与RTK输入不同，完整输入和全窗覆盖在配表中。
caption_en: Heading accuracy across filtering and factor-graph methods with the completed FGO position routes retained. (a–f) Signed heading errors and absolute-error ECDFs on common nominal dynamic epochs (274/267/367) for the six heading-estimating configurations. Gray shading marks registered obstruction; missing dynamic outputs break curves. Original initialization conventions are retained. (g,h) The first registered20-s position interruption and whole-run heading RMSE for all18 conditions; the gray dash-dot curve is the baseline-retaining IEKF and black ticks indicate medians. (i) Existing horizontal RMSE for OiSAM, TC-FGO and GNC-FGO at the same GNSS1 antenna point and their separately registered common dynamic support (274/267/369). TC/GNC do not estimate attitude in these implementations. LegSA-GINS position metrics are registered at the POI and are not mixed into this antenna-point panel. Raw-code and RTK inputs differ; full input definitions and window coverage accompany the figure.
